purpose: Collect only secret-free, read-only project facts before the Bootstrap Interview; discovery never answers owner intent or mutates external state.

permission.manual_mode: Do not run discovery when the owner selects MANUAL.

fact_contract.value_rule: Values are limited to typed, secret-free observations; an observed fact never becomes owner intent without confirmation.
fact_contract.conflict_rule: Conflicts and unknowns are surfaced for the Interview; Bootstrap may not silently choose between them.

allowed: local Git repository identity and origin shape
installed local tool metadata without invoking provider authentication
authority, design, stack, and delivery marker presence
inspection.unsafe_filesystem_objects: Report symlinks and non-regular objects as CONFLICT; never follow them.
